title: Circuit extension and CNF satisfiability
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits, with each gate reading at most two vertices, and let $\sigma:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$ be an assignment. There exists an assignment $\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$ agreeing with $\sigma$ on every index below $n$ and satisfying the CNF encoding of $C$ if and only if $C$ evaluates to true on the first $n$ bits specified by $\sigma$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs
Every gate of $C$ has at most two arguments
$\sigma$ is a Boolean-valued assignment on the natural numbers
